label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'host' variable (from request.getParameter) flows directly to URI creation at sink line 27. Although DNS resolution and non-public address checking occur, the HTTP request is made to the original hostname ('http://' + host), not the validated IP. Attacker can supply arbitrary hostnames that pass the non-public check (public domains) to perform SSRF. Resolved sink value = attacker-controlled hostname.

evidence.note: User input param -> host variable flows to URI.create('http://' + host) at sink line 27
